steps.text: All Wildlife tokens in the cloth bag; shake well
Take {n} random Habitat tiles facedown without looking; box the rest
Shuffle them into facedown stacks within reach
Shuffle them into facedown stacks on the left of the play area
Randomly pick 1 Wildlife Scoring card for each of the 5 wildlife
steps.note: First game: use the cards marked A

steps.text: Use only the Family Variant scoring card
Use only the Intermediate Variant scoring card
Deal each player 1 random Starter Habitat tile faceup; box the rest
Reveal {n} Habitat tiles and pair each with a token drawn from the bag
All 4 tokens the same: wipe and redraw them automatically
3 tokens the same: the active player may wipe those 3, once per turn
Spend a Nature token: take any tile with any token, or wipe any tokens
Solo: before refilling, discard the tile and token furthest from the stacks and slide the rest
Whoever most recently saw one of the wildlife goes first (or pick randomly)
Take a tile + token pair and place both in your area
